metadata.datasource: FUJIFILM PROFESSIONAL DATA GUIDE, publication AF3-207U (FUJIFILM, 2005), p. 55: FUJICHROME Sensia 100 [RA], ISO 100/21°, Daylight Type; spectral sensitivity (density 1.0 over D-min), characteristic curves (Status A, E-6/CR-56), spectral dye density (C/M/Y), digitised from the PDF's vector paths
metadata.copyright: SpektraLab product data. Not a spektrafilm profile; no array is read from one.
metadata.license: Built from FUJIFILM publication AF3-207U. See engine/resources_product/NOTICE.md.
metadata.method: spektrafilm's profile factory (9428440, GPL-3.0): D-min removed (and laid in as base), green at the 18 % transmittance density put at log exposure 0, Status A unmixed through the published C/M/Y dyes, three normal CDFs per layer, D55 balance; then the shipped profiles' form reproduced from them: each dye at unit Status A density, sensitivity tails as an exponential approach (tau 120 nm), an sRGB 18 % grey at log exposure 0 through hanatos2025 (adaptation off), hanatos2025 window (erf4, widths 26.4/56.0 nm as the Portra NC/VC product profiles) + surface (poly4) fitted to Otsu, Munsell, UEF forest and Japan natural-object reflectances under D55, upstream's positive grey-ramp correction (scanned, -1..+2 EV, trustability 1) run through the SpektraLab engine, CDFs refitted, mid grey re-anchored.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET inside the plotted range (absolute log axis); ASSUMED tails (exponential approach); level FITTED (sRGB 18 % grey -> 0)
tags.density_curves: SHEET (Status A, unmixed), FITTED (3 CDFs per layer, grey-ramp scale/shift); ASSUMED beyond the plotted exposures (the CDFs' own toe and shoulder); where the sheet draws one line for coinciding records, the hidden records take that line (fraction of the plotted range: {"r": 0.0, "g": 0.502, "b": 0.505})
tags.channel_density: SHEET (C/M/Y spectral dye density, 'separated light', peak 1.0) less the sheet's constant offset (0.005: min(Y, M) at 650-700 nm), rescaled to unit Status A density
tags.base_density: FITTED (the characteristic curves' D-min, smoothed across the Status A peaks)
tags.midscale_neutral_density: DERIVED (the dyes at mid grey over the base)
tags.hanatos2025_adaptation: FITTED (reflectance sets above; window widths held at the Portra NC/VC product profiles')
tags.info: SHEET: process E-6/CR-56, ISO 100/21°, Daylight Type; ASSUMED antihalation strong, D55 reference, no print (scanned)

digitisation.labels_note: axis residual = largest gap between a tick label's value and the line fitted through the grid lines it labels

fit_residuals.dye_model: published C/M/Y spectral dye densities (normalised to peak 1.0, 'separated light')
